LESSON: MIRACLES OF PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3.2: Miracles of Prophets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Miracles of Prophets. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is a miracle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
2. explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets
3. appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MIRACLES OF PROPHETS
This lesson teaches Miracles of Prophets for Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Miracles of Prophets using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Miracles of Prophets above.
2. Explain Miracles of Prophets to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Miracles of Prophets.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Miracles of Prophets with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Miracles of Prophets important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is a miracle?
2. Why did prophets perform miracles?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
2. explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets
3. appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
